final_answer: In Age of Empires IV, the Japanese civilization in Age 4 can choose between two strategic paths: boosting trade or cultivating gunpowder weaponry. Boosting trade involves building the Castle of the Crow, which acts as a Keep and generates Treasure Caravans that can traverse land or water to trade at any Trade Post. Cultivating gunpowder weaponry involves building the Tanegashima Gunsmith, which grants access to an arsenal of gunpowder units, including the Ozutsu heavy ranged infantry.
